translation: Took place in posad Serock, 20 April 1890, 8 AM. Appeared personally Jankiel Borensztejn, szkolnik, 36, and Hersz Morgensztern, teacher, 30, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 9 AM in posad Serock died a child of female sex named Frajda Finkielsztejn, daughter of Fajf[?] and Cytla[?] nee Piekarz, aged six months. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and by them.
